title: Weight loss
author: Talha A.
desc: Kickstart your fitness journey with this focused one-week weight loss program designed for intermediate lifters. Comprising a single, intense 90-minute workout, you'll engage in a variety of exercises targeting your chest, arms, and shoulders, including assisted dips, landmine presses, and cable crossovers. This program emphasizes strength and muscle building while promoting fat loss, making it perfect for those ready to challenge themselves. Equip yourself with a full gym and get ready to transform your body!
